suggestions.description: Units that would benefit from a content change, based on the provided course structure.

unit_id.description: The exact 'location_id' of the unit this suggestion applies to, copied verbatim from the provided course outline.

unit_display_name.description: The display name of the unit, copied from the provided course outline, for readability.

type.description: The category of improvement this suggestion addresses.

priority.description: How important this suggestion is relative to others.

title.description: A short, action-oriented headline for this suggestion (e.g. 'Rename this unit', 'Add a worked example').

suggestion.description: The full description of the suggestion, explaining what to change and why.

proposed_change.description: A concrete, final, ready-to-use replacement text, ONLY when one genuinely applies. Must be null when the suggestion is open-ended (no specific replacement text to give).

field.description: Which unit field this concrete change applies to.

current.description: The current value of that field, copied verbatim from the provided course data.

suggested.description: The proposed replacement value, ready to use as-is.
